newsitem.title: USA: Half Hollow Hills CSD, N.Y. sells $28.7 mln TANs.
newsitem.headline: Half Hollow Hills CSD, N.Y. sells $28.7 mln TANs.

text.p: Half Hollow Hills Central School District (CSD), N,Y., said it sold $28.7 million of tax anticipation notes (TANs) to three firms in a competitive auction.
First Albany Corp. won $21.7 million of the TANs with a four percent coupon and a net interest cost (NIC) of 3.84913 percent.
Fleet Securities won $5 million of the notes with a 4.25 percent coupon and a NIC of 3.75578 percent.
Chase Securities won $2 million of the notes with a 4.25 percent coupon and 3.812 percent NIC. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
